changed.text: A curated collection of resources and projects focused on AppImage.
AppImageを扱う資料や関連プロジェクトをまとめたAwesomeリストです。

changed.before: [AppImage](https://appimage.org) is a community-based format to distribute applications to various mainstream Linux distributions without the need for a centralized store. One app = one file! This list contains tools to work with AppImages, such as to create AppImages for applications and to integrate AppImages into the system easily. As the vibrant community around AppImage is growing, so is this list.
changed.after: The source describes [AppImage](https://appimage.org) as a community-based format for distributing applications to mainstream Linux distributions without a centralized store: one app, one file.

changed.before: - [AppImageUpdate](https://github.com/AppImage/AppImageUpdate) - Official grapical application to update AppImages; command-line tool to update AppImages.
changed.after: - [AppImageUpdate](https://github.com/AppImage/AppImageUpdate) - Official graphical application to update AppImages; command-line tool to update AppImages.

changed.before: - [leap](https://github.com/lnxcz/leap) - Fast and simple AppImage manager. Written in Rust.
changed.after: - [leap](https://github.com/lnxcz/leap) - Simple AppImage manager. Written in Rust.
